quotes.quote: Total 101 lesions were included. Forty-three lesions were treated with cryotherapy and 58 lesions were assigned as control.
At the fourth month, dermatologists' assessment revealed that 82.3% of the treated lesions comparing to only 2% of the control showed more than 75% improvement (p < .001).
A single session of tip cryotherapy was delivered and remained for 5 s.
Total 101 lesions were included. Forty-three lesions were treated with cryotherapy and 58 lesions were assigned as control.
At the fourth month, dermatologists' assessment revealed that 82.3% of the treated lesions comparing to only 2% of the control showed more than 75% improvement (p < .001).
Total 101 lesions were included. Forty-three lesions were treated with cryotherapy and 58 lesions were assigned as control.
the score of the treated lesions has been significantly lower than that of the control lesions since week 8 (p = .005).
Colorimeter was used to measure lesional luminosity at baseline and then monthly until 4 months.
Burning sensation was the most common side effect.
